why: Check verifies the second of two consecutive same-type entries still shows its background-colored badge, naming the repeated color as the cache-path trigger; key changes say a repeated color name returns the cache table.

Names scrollbars skipped by an early render return and says to watch for scrollbars disappearing mid-drag-select, but ties it to the marquee rather than any selected element; the zoom check with selection outlines and scrollbars is only about alignment.
Handle checks are at default zoom; the zoom check covers element rendering, not the rotation handle's distance from the element.
Grouping checks cover dragging, outline and undo only; no check of z-order or stacking after Ctrl+G.
Check: after a point drag a single undo returns the shape to its pre-drag state, and a drag then undo restores the previous shape; notes Alt-click resumes history recording.
Drag checks use single or multi-selection and never drag a member of a group whose selection expands to the whole group.
Notes the button renders only when a handler is supplied, but no check verifies the button is absent without a handler; only checks the entry point opens the dialog.
Generous: 'reloading the page with a saved drawing centers the view on the drawing', with uncertainty saying to run on an offset/embedded placement; offset not in the check itself.
Only clearing text (deleting it) and detach is checked; no check edits bound text and verifies the arrow stays bound.
Only groups text-filled shapes after text exists; does not create bound text inside an already grouped container.
Popup position checks never use a non-zero editor/canvas offset.
Only checks control shown for single shape with text and hidden with a plain shape; neither the empty selection nor the shape+bound-text mixed selection is checked.
Mentions the handle is kept for dropped files but no check opens via picker and saves back to the same file.
Click inside the selected bent line's bounding box on empty space and expect it to pass through (not grab the line); near the deselect trigger but does not state deselection explicitly.
Handle rendering checks never place another element over the line being edited or drag covered points.
Footer child render check has no production/minified build condition; explains name-based child matching but does not test minified.
Names the deleted-element handling in drag-duplication loop but the drag-duplicate check has no deleted elements or undo/sync restore.
Tests H toggling the hand tool but never Alt+Shift+H distribute horizontally.
Checks toggle API accepts a tab and force, but not switching tabs on an already-open sidebar nor that it must stay open.
Undo/store checks with no older browser lacking Object.hasOwn.
Check that searching dark/light/mode/theme/toggle finds 'Toggle theme' uses lowercase queries against a capitalized label, but never states case-insensitivity; generous reading.
Checks button disabled states and that view-mode toggles add no undo step, but never exits view mode and inspects undo/redo button enabled state.
Alt-click add-point is only checked on normal non-elbow lines; elbow checks only cover editor not opening and segment drag, no Alt+click on an elbow arrow.
Explicitly flags that laser trails now vanish immediately on release instead of fading gradually, with a check on release; but the check frames the instant clear as expected, so generous.
Startup and Android/mobile checks only; nothing about navigator.platform or userAgent being undefined or the app loading in such an environment.
Delete checks cover messages and chats but never check that the diagram preview updates after a message is removed.
Repeated-arrow growth check looks at first nodes staying put and spacing, not centering of the pending cluster on the parent; centering only asserted for a single first node.
Insertion/paste/draw-in-frame checks never delete a frame child stacked above the frame first, so the trigger is missing.
